title: Delegation summary note trigger: negation and severity-adjective checks span clauses ('High throughput verified; 0 issues.' gives a false note)
outcome: In src/delegation_result_parser.rs (delegation_result_summary_reports_findings, around :221), the count check requires the count's clause to match its finding noun, but the negation words (no/not/zero/without) and the severity-adjective shortcut (actionable/critical/high/low/medium in the before-window) still look across clause boundaries. So 'High throughput verified; 0 issues.' with Findings: None yields a false, non-actionable inconsistency note. It is pre-existing in kind and costs only a note, never an actionable finding, since an explicit Findings: None wins.
acceptance: Delegation summary note trigger: negation and severity-adjective checks span clauses ('High throughput verified; 0 issues.' gives a false note) is done
